feeds.title: Gardening in South Africa
feeds.description: On this website, you will find not only flowers of incredible beauty but also handy hints on how to grow and nurture them, how to protect them without poisoning plant life, and the myriad of creepy crawlies that are part of their symbiotic circle. Gardening in South Africa will also guide you on how to plant vegetables, herbs, and other yummy things to enhance a healthy diet.

feeds.title: Life is a Garden Blog
feeds.description: Life is a Garden brings relevant industry-endorsed information, at the right time of the year, to interested gardeners across Southern Africa.

feeds.title: The Botanical Society of South Africa Blog
feeds.description: The Botanical Society of South Africa is a member-driven organization that offers citizen scientists, amateur nature enthusiasts, the general public, and environmental experts the opportunity to join hands and be a part of the solutions to biodiversity challenges across the country

feeds.title: Lifestyle Home Garden Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1988 by Michael Gibbons, Deighton Clegg and Oscar Lockwood, Lifestyle Home Garden is the palmy result of a shared vision to not only develop a garden centre but to create a nursery and lifestyle environment different from any other garden centre present in South Africa at the time. With the goal being to do more than just sell plants to our customers, Lifestyle Home Garden has blossomed into a fully-fledged and flourishing garden centre that offers additional products and services.

feeds.title: Cape Contours Blog
feeds.description: Explore our gardening blog for landscaping tips, news, and reviews. Also Cape Contour's garden design specials and inspiration from around the world. Cape Contours provide a variety of quality landscaping services: Landscape creation, implementation & maintenance for residential and commercial properties.

feeds.title: Tools4Garden
feeds.description: Gardening Articles, DIY project plans, tool reviews, and more on Tools4Garden.co.za. Tools4Garden is a new website specializing in supplying gardening tools, accessories, and consumables direct to your home. Our aim is to provide clients with a massive and complete range of quality tools from one place, coupled with quick nationwide delivery.

feeds.title: Eckards Blog
feeds.description: Eckards Garden Pavilion is the largest independently owned garden centre in Bedfordview. Consistently in the Top Ten garden centres in SA as graded by GCA.

feeds.title: Wonder
feeds.description: Wonder plant nutrition and fertilizer solutions have provided South African gardeners with a diverse range of plant nutrition and care solutions for over 40 years. Gardens are beautiful, bountiful, and balanced with Wonder. Offering easy solutions to feed and protect lawns, trees, shrubs, roses and flowers. One stop home protection against flying and crawling insects, and rodents.

feeds.title: Stanler Farms Blog
feeds.description: Stanler Farms is a family-run business established in 1975. We are now a third-generation company operating in both the Western Cape and Gauteng. At Stanler Farms, we are proud and confident of our product, as attested to by the lush gardens, award-winning golf courses, bowling greens, and fertile agricultural lands of our clients.

feeds.title: Garden Day Blog
feeds.description: Garden Day is an annual movement for green-fingered folk to celebrate the fruits of their labor with family and friends. The Garden Day Blog shares interesting posts and articles introducing readers to the many eclectic traditions and aspects of Garden Day Celebrations. Learn about the Health Benefits of Gardening, Recipes, Tips and more.

feeds.title: GARDENING.co.za Blog
feeds.description: Gardening.co.za is South Africa's leading online gardening shop & resource. Dig into their comprehensive guides, latest trends, and exclusive products for all your gardening needs. View Gardening advice and Explainer articles addressing common issues faced by beginners to keep them motivated about Gardening.

feeds.title: Ludwig's Roses
feeds.description: Ludwig's Roses was established in March 1971. We grow the largest selection of rose varieties available anywhere in the world.

feeds.title: Windy Willows Blog
feeds.description: Windy Willows is a wholesale growing nursery located in Honeydew, Johannesburg. We propagate and stock over 200 varieties of trees, shrubs, perennial flowers, groundcovers, and grasses. In addition to plants, we offer the following services: landscaping design and installation, irrigation design and installation, and more

feeds.title: Just Berry Plants Blog
feeds.description: Linda and Bev are the faces behind the Just Berry Plants name. These sisters share a passion for teaching gardeners and communities how to grow their own produce. In this way, they are empowered and uplifted, able to provide for their families and enjoy the fruits of their labor. We don't just sell plants. We give advice and tips on how to help our plants thrive in their new home.

feeds.title: SA Garden&Home » Gardening
feeds.description: Enjoy articles on Gardening How-to's, with detailed guides, informative ideas, and general insights from experts at SA Garden&Home. As one of SA's favourite decor & gardening mags featuring stylish homes & gardens, the latest lifestyle, SA Garden&Home provides a refreshing, clear focus on various aspects of the gardening, and horticulture industry in South Africa.

feeds.title: GREENIDIOM.COM
feeds.description: The Home Gardening blog keeps you up to date with additions to the Greenidiom website. Browse ideas and tips on how you can design a sanctuary for life, grow native plants, nutrient-dense foods, soil, and biodiversity. Explore different aspects of nature-friendly garden practice and achieve greater bio-diversity with Greenidiom.

feeds.title: Whisker Flowers
feeds.description: Whisker Flowers is a blog about sustainable kitchen vegetable gardening in South Africa featuring a comprehensive library & how-to guides. Enjoy regular posts on how to grow vegetables, fruits, and herbs and several article series of vegetable profiles, biological control via insects, chicken keeping, home composting, and whatever else the author finds interesting.

feeds.title: Tanya Visser Blog
feeds.description: Tanya Visser is a popular Gardening personality in South Africa and television presenter of the Home Channel's popular show, The Gardener. In her blog, she breaks down important concepts related to Gardening while also offering critically useful insights, tips, tool recommendations, and more to keep gardening enthusiasts informed.

feeds.title: Get It Ballito Umhlanga Blog » Gardening
feeds.description: Find inspiration from Get It magazine's home, garden & décor articles. From Gardening tips and décor must-haves, these articles feature some of the most stunning homes in your neighborhood. Get It Ballito Umhlanga is a glossy, community magazine focusing on people, shopping and lifestyle on the North Coast of KZN.

feeds.title: The Gardener
feeds.description: For everyone who loves gardening! We inspire the home enthusiast with practical, creative ideas for maintaining & enhancing the garden, patio & backyard.

feeds.title: Random Harvest Blog
feeds.description: Random Harvest is an indigenous Highveld plant retail and wholesale nursery that has been supplying landscapers and landscape architects for over 25 years.
